headline: NYM @ SEA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYM 3.21 at SEA 4.29, with a projected total of 7.50. NRFI probability dropped -20.6%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Batter research is strongest for Julio Rodríguez, Cole Young, Juan Soto, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Vidal Bruján, Rob Refsnyder because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
